Extracted via extract-primeng-source.mjs from primeng@21.1.9. Adapts only upstream's `Button` component class (lines 576-917 of the extracted file) — not the same file's `ButtonDirective`/`ButtonLabel`/`ButtonIcon` directives, which are out of scope for this task's file list. Button→UButton, selector p-button→u-button, extends UBaseComponent (Task 4), renders a native <button> (matching upstream's own template, not a <div> with ARIA role). Deliberately excludes upstream's passthrough (pt/ptm/Bind) system, buttonProps bulk-props input, badge/badgeSeverity/badgeClass inputs, type/style/styleClass/tabindex/variant/link/plain inputs, autofocus input, ariaLabel input, and content-template (contentTemplate/iconTemplate/loadingIconTemplate) support — none of these appear in this task's Interfaces section, which defines a smaller, spec-mandated signal-input surface. DISCREPANCY: Step 5 instructs importing URipple/UAutoFocus/UFluid/UBadge/USpinnerIcon into the component's `imports` array; only URipple/USpinnerIcon are imported here. UAutoFocus, UFluid, and UBadge are excluded because none can be applied in the template without inputs this task's own Interfaces section omits (no autofocus or badge input is listed for UButton) — an Angular standalone component with an unused `imports` entry fails compilation with NG8113 (confirmed by actually adding all 5 and rebuilding), and applying UAutoFocus's bare `uAutoFocus` selector to silence that warning is not inert (its aliased @Input reads the bare attribute as a truthy string, unconditionally triggering focus() on init — a real behavior change, confirmed against UAutoFocus's own spec). Upstream's real Button never renders a <p-fluid> element itself either — it DI-injects Fluid purely to detect an ancestor <p-fluid> wrapper, a host-DI-lookup mechanism UBaseComponent's scoped-down Option B architecture has no equivalent for; UButton's own `fluid` input already drives `.u-button-fluid` directly via ButtonStyle's classes.root. Upstream's <p-badge> is likewise rendered only conditionally on a `badge` input this task's Interfaces section doesn't define.

Extracted via extract-primeng-source.mjs from primeng@21.1.9. Tooltip→UTooltip, selector [pTooltip]→[uTooltip], extends UBaseComponent (Task 4). Deliberately excludes upstream's much larger prop surface (tooltipEvent/positionStyle/tooltipStyleClass/tooltipZIndex/escape/showDelay/hideDelay/life/positionTop/positionLeft/autoHide/fitContent/hideOnEscape/showOnEllipsis/tooltipOptions/appendTo), its TemplateRef content type, its touch/click/document-escape/scroll/resize listener wiring, its ConnectedOverlayScrollHandler, its p-dialog ancestor special-case, and its ellipsis-detection gate — none of these appear in this task's Interfaces section, which defines a smaller, spec-mandated signal-input surface (uTooltip/uTooltipPosition/uTooltipDisabled). DISCREPANCY: upstream's align() tries up to 4 positions in a priority-fallback order via isOutOfBounds()/getHostOffset()/preAlign(); this task's brief only asks to position the tooltip per the single uTooltipPosition input (matching UTooltipOptions' plain `position` field, which has no fallback-order concept), so a single fixed-position alignment was implemented instead of porting the 4-way fallback search, with a horizontal-only viewport clamp using getViewport() (per this task's Interfaces section) rather than upstream's full out-of-bounds re-alignment. Z-index: upstream calls ZIndexUtils.set('tooltip', el, this.config.zIndex.tooltip) (a global-config-driven base); this project's UltimateConfig (Task 4's scoped-down config) has no zIndex sub-config, so a literal base of 1100 is used via @ultimate/uix-utils's ZIndex singleton (ZIndex.set(key, element, baseZIndex) — matching packages/ng-core/src/overlay/overlay.ts's established call pattern), placed above UOverlay's 1000 base.

Extracted via extract-primeng-source.mjs from primeng@21.1.9. Checkbox→UCheckbox, selector p-checkbox→u-checkbox, extends UBaseEditableHolder (Task 5). Deliberately excludes upstream's much larger prop surface: value/trueValue/falseValue (multi-value/group-checkbox mode — this task's Interfaces section defines only binary; UCheckbox only implements upstream's boolean/binary mode, writeValue always coerces to a plain boolean rather than upstream's array-membership contains() check for multi-value mode), ariaLabelledBy/ariaLabel/tabindex/inputId/inputStyle/styleClass/inputClass/readonly/autofocus/variant/size/checkboxIcon/formControl inputs, indeterminate state, the icon <ng-template>/ContentChild template-override system, and the onChange/onFocus/onBlur output()s — none of these appear in this task's Interfaces section, which defines a smaller, spec-mandated signal-input surface (binary, label, inherited disabled) with 'no UCheckbox-specific outputs beyond the CVA contract.' Renders no check/minus icon: upstream's CheckIcon/MinusIcon has no equivalent yet in @ultimate/ng-core's icon set (spinner/times/window-maximize/window-minimize only so far per Task 9's finding) and no icon-related input is listed in this task's Interfaces section; checked state is instead conveyed via .u-checkbox-checked on the root and the native input's own checked state. providers: [NG_VALUE_ACCESSOR] is declared directly on UCheckbox (not inherited) — confirmed during Task 5 that UBaseEditableHolder provides no NG_VALUE_ACCESSOR of its own, matching upstream's own CHECKBOX_VALUE_ACCESSOR constant redeclared on Checkbox rather than inherited from BaseEditableHolder. Template binds the native input's [disabled] to $disabled() (the combined computed signal), never to the base disabled() input alone — empirically verified: binding to disabled() alone fails a test asserting setDisabledState (CVA path, with the disabled input never bound) disables the rendered input, while binding to $disabled() passes it. Migrated to writeControlValue bridge (GAP-038): own checked signal stays authoritative, writeControlValue populates checked AND (via setModelValue) modelValue in parallel; toggle() also calls writeModelValue, keeping modelValue/$filled in sync on user-driven writes (click/Space).

Ported from the extracted CheckboxStyle's own `style`/`classes` shape, but reshaped to a plain {css, classes} object matching UBaseComponent's styleModule contract (Task 4's base-component.spec.ts — no @Injectable DI service, unlike upstream's own @Injectable CheckboxStyle extends BaseStyle). `style` is imported from @ultimate/uix-styles/checkbox (style-only, no classes export — Task 3's corrected finding that @primeuix/styles never exports a classes object). `classes` (root/box/input/icon) ported locally with .p-checkbox*→.u-checkbox* renaming, reshaped to take a plain params object directly rather than upstream's `{ instance }`-wrapped signature — confirmed against UBaseComponent.cx(key, params)'s actual call contract, matching the same pattern already established by ButtonStyle/BadgeStyle/TooltipStyle. classes.root's `p-highlight`/`p-disabled` modifier classes are deliberately kept unrenamed (not u-highlight/u-disabled): confirmed against @ultimate/uix-styles/checkbox's own CSS export, whose selectors (`.p-disabled`, `.p-invalid`, `.p-variant-filled`) reference these PrimeNG-wide structural/shared modifier classes literally, unrenamed — the style module must emit matching literal class names for those CSS selectors to apply. `invalid`/`$variant`/`size` params dropped from classes.root's resolver: no invalid, variant, or size input exists on UCheckbox per this task's Interfaces section.

Extracted via extract-primeng-source.mjs from primeng@21.1.9. Dialog→UDialog, selector p-dialog→u-dialog, extends UBaseComponent (Task 4). Deliberately excludes upstream's much larger prop/behavior surface — draggable/resizable drag-and-resize listener wiring, breakpoints/dynamic <style> injection, dismissableMask, position (top/bottom/left/right/corner variants), maskStyle/maskStyleClass/contentStyle/contentStyleClass/styleClass, blockScroll/body-scroll blocking, keepInViewport, content/footer/icon TemplateRef projection slots, rtl, maximizable, and the p-dialog[id] breakpoint <style> element — none of these appear in this task's Interfaces section, which defines a smaller, spec-mandated signal-input surface: visible, header, closable, closeOnEscape, modal. DISCREPANCY (brief vs. working code): the brief's Step 5 instructs importing UTimesIcon/UWindowMaximizeIcon/UWindowMinimizeIcon into `imports`; only UTimesIcon is imported — UWindowMaximizeIcon/UWindowMinimizeIcon are deliberately excluded because no `maximizable` input exists in this task's Interfaces section to gate a maximize button on, so neither icon can appear in the template, and an Angular standalone component with an unused template reference in `imports` fails compilation with NG8113 (confirmed directly — build failed on this exact error before removing the two unused imports), matching UButton's own documented Task 12 precedent. Overlay/focus-trap wiring: per the Phase 2 Overlay Architecture responsibility split, UOverlay (Task 6) only moves the host element to document.body and assigns/clears a z-index, and UFocusTrap (Task 6) only traps Tab/Shift+Tab within the host's focusable descendants — UDialog, as the only overlay component built in this phase, wires UOverlay + UFocusTrap + @ultimate/uix-motion's createMotion together directly in its own class/template, per the spec's explicit YAGNI call (no shared "overlay orchestration service" abstraction, since there is exactly one consumer this phase). @ultimate/uix-motion's real, verified export is `createMotion(element, options): MotionInstance` (packages/uix-motion/src/config/index.ts) — not the MotionModule/pMotion structural directive PrimeNG's own Angular-specific @primeuix/motion package exposes (used in the extracted dialog.ts template as [pMotion]="visible" [pMotionName]="'p-dialog'" etc.); @ultimate/uix-motion has no such Angular directive, so enter/leave is driven imperatively via an effect() watching visible() calling createMotion(rootEl, {name: 'u-dialog', appear: true}).enter()/.leave(). Escape handling: upstream's bindDocumentEscapeListener (.vendor-extracted/ng/dialog/dialog.ts lines ~1051-1066) additionally guards on the closing dialog's z-index matching the current top-of-stack z-index via ZIndexUtils.getCurrent() (a nested-dialogs-close-only-the-topmost-one safety check); this task's UOverlay hardcodes its z-index registry key to "overlay" for every instance (a Minor note carried from Task 6's review) and @ultimate/uix-utils's ZIndex singleton exposes no getCurrent() equivalent, so there is no working multi-dialog stacking order to compare against — a plain document-level keydown.escape host listener (unconditional on z-index, guarded only by closeOnEscape() and visible()) is used instead, matching this task's brief/spec (Step 5, Step 2's test); this is not a regression to fix speculatively since UOverlay's single-bucket registry means nested UDialogs aren't a real usable scenario yet. Focus-return-on-close: PrimeNG's own extracted source (confirmed by reading dialog.ts in full) has no logic capturing/restoring document.activeElement around the visibility transition — its focus() method only moves focus into the dialog on show via focusOnShow/_focus(); nothing moves it back out on hide. This task's own spec test ("returns focus to the triggering element when closed") operationalizes that gap: document.activeElement is captured in the same effect() when visible() transitions to true, and restored via .focus() when it transitions to false — implemented explicitly here to close the accessibility gap the Phase 2 spec flagged as unverified in PrimeNG's own source.

Extracted via extract-primeng-source.mjs from primeng@21.1.9. Ported from PrimeNG's own extracted DialogStyle (.vendor-extracted/ng/dialog/style/dialogstyle.ts), shaped to match UBaseComponent's `styleModule: {css, classes}` contract (Task 4) — a plain object field, not an @Injectable service (PrimeNG's own Dialog DI-injects its style service via `_componentStyle = inject(DialogStyle)`, but this project's scoped-down Option B architecture does not). Per Task 3's corrected finding that @primeuix/styles never exports a `classes` object, @ultimate/uix-styles/dialog exports only `style` (verified: packages/uix-styles/src/dialog/index.ts) — the `classes` class-name-slot resolver is ported here instead, locally, from the extracted reference file's own `const classes = {...}`, with `.p-dialog*` selectors renamed to `.u-dialog*`, matching the pattern ButtonStyle/TooltipStyle/CheckboxStyle/BadgeStyle already establish. The extracted classes.mask/classes.root resolvers take `({ instance })` and read PrimeNG's instance.position/instance.modal/instance.maximizable/instance.maximized fields directly off the component instance — dropped here since UBaseComponent.cx(key, params) invokes styleModule.classes[key](params) with a flat params object the caller passes (packages/ng-core/src/basecomponent/base-component.ts), not an `{ instance }` wrapper, matching the same adaptation already made by ButtonStyle/TooltipStyle; UDialog has no position/maximizable/maximized inputs per this task's Interfaces section, so those position/maximized-aware branches are dropped from classes.mask/classes.root. inlineStyles (upstream's mask/root inline `position: fixed` etc.) is not ported: this task's Interfaces section defines no inline-style input surface for UDialog, and UOverlay (Task 6) already owns positioning/z-index for the moved-to-body host element.

Test taken from this task's brief (Step 2), with two additions: (1) `import { describe, expect, it } from "vitest";` (the brief's snippet omitted it, unlike every other spec file in this package — vitest globals are not enabled in this project's tsconfig, so the snippet as given fails to compile; same discrepancy already documented for tooltip.spec.ts/checkbox.spec.ts); (2) the "returns focus to the triggering element when closed" test's second `fixture.detectChanges()` call (after the second plain-property mutation, `visible = false`, on the zoneless host) was changed to `fixture.changeDetectorRef.markForCheck(); fixture.detectChanges(false); await fixture.whenStable();` — as written verbatim, the brief's plain `detectChanges()` call hit NG0100 (ExpressionChangedAfterItHasBeenCheckedError) on this project's zoneless Angular 21 TestBed, confirmed to be a test-mechanics issue (not a UDialog defect) and already precedented twice in this exact codebase for the identical two-plain-mutations-in-one-test pattern: packages/ng-core/src/overlay/overlay.spec.ts and packages/ng-core/src/bind/bind.spec.ts both hit it and both fixed it in the test with this exact markForCheck/detectChanges(false)/whenStable sequence.

Deliberately excludes upstream's much larger surface (popup overlay positioning/show()/hide()/toggle(), appendTo/z-index stacking, motion, submenu nesting, TemplateRef content-projection slots, styleClass/style inputs, ariaLabel/ariaLabelledBy, document click/resize/scroll listeners, the separate MenuItemContent child-component split, and the Home/End/Enter/Space/Escape/Tab key handlers upstream's onListKeyDown() implements) — none of these appear in this task's Interfaces section (model, popup only). Roving tabindex: real PrimeNG uses a virtual-focus/aria-activedescendant pattern (focusedOptionIndex signal, no native DOM focus movement between items), confirmed by reading menu.ts lines 698-761; this task's own brief and spec test (asserting document.activeElement moves) give an explicit, different resolution — a literal roving-tabindex pattern (move tabindex 0/-1 between anchors, call .focus()) — followed here per the brief's explicit override of the default 'adapt to real source' rule. Tooltip/Router wiring: real PrimeNG applies pTooltip/routerLink via a separate MenuItemContent child component; adapted here as direct [uTooltip]/[routerLink] bindings on this component's own <a>, same load-bearing behavior (truncated-label tooltips confirmed genuinely used by real Menu — this is the Menu→Tooltip dependency the Phase 2 spec's own research surfaced), same @angular/router peer dependency. UBadge deliberately excluded from imports: UMenuItem (Task 10) has no badge field, so no template element can bind one — matches UButton's (Task 12) and UDialog's (Task 15) documented NG8113 precedent for unused imports.

Extracted via extract-primeng-source.mjs from primeng@21.1.9. InputNumber→UInputNumber, selector p-inputnumber→u-inputnumber, extends UBaseInput (the richer input-config tier — min/max/step/pattern/etc — that UInputText skips, matching real InputNumber extends BaseInput). Unlike UInputText (an attribute directive implementing no CVA of its own), UInputNumber IS a @Component and DOES implement ControlValueAccessor directly via providers: [NG_VALUE_ACCESSOR], a genuine architectural difference between the two real components. value = signal<number|null>(null) is this component's own local state (a signal, not a plain field, so OnPush re-renders on .set() without a manual markForCheck() call — final-review fix: a plain field left the rendered <input> stale on Forms-driven writes) — writeControlValue populates BOTH value (real state) AND modelValue/$filled (via setModelValue) from the same CVA write, matching UCheckbox's established pattern (Task 2); onInput also calls writeModelValue directly, keeping modelValue in sync on user-driven changes. clampToRange is a scoped-down port of real source's validateValue (only min/max branches; locale/currency/grouping explicitly excluded per spec), applied from CVA writes and user input only — NOT re-applied merely because min/max change while a value is already set. writeControlValue now passes the CLAMPED value (not the raw CVA-written value) into setModelValue and also calls onModelChange with it, so value/modelValue/the FormControl all agree after a clamp (final-review fix: previously only value was clamped, leaving modelValue and the FormControl unclamped). Deliberately excludes locale-aware Intl.NumberFormat formatting, clipboard paste handling, cursor/caret-position insertion logic, configurable spinner button layouts (showButtons/buttonLayout), prefix/suffix/currency/locale inputs — all out of scope per spec's Non-Goals. Ships via real secondary entry point (@ultimate/ng/input-number subpath), not main barrel, since input-number.ts has zero direct import of UFluid's class — ancestor-fluid detection happens entirely within UBaseInput/ng-core via the U_FLUID_ANCESTOR token.

Ported from the extracted InputNumberStyle's own style/classes shape, reshaped to a plain {css, classes} object matching UBaseComponent's styleModule contract (Task 4 — no @Injectable DI service, unlike upstream's own @Injectable InputNumberStyle). style is imported from @ultimate/uix-styles/inputnumber (style-only, no classes export — Task 3's corrected finding that @primeuix/styles never exports a classes object). classes.root resolver takes a plain params object (invalid/fluid) matching UBaseComponent.cx(key, params)'s actual call contract, ported locally with .p-inputnumber*→.u-inputnumber* renaming, and reflects invalid/fluid on the HOST element — matching real source's own classes.root resolver, which puts both p-inputnumber-fluid and p-invalid on InputNumber's own host. classes.pcInputText is a bare 'u-inputnumber-input' string with no modifiers, matching real source's own pcInputText resolver exactly (final-review fix: an earlier revision incorrectly placed invalid/fluid on pcInputText instead of root, which left @ultimate/uix-styles/inputnumber's `.u-inputnumber-fluid .u-inputnumber-input` descendant-selector fluid-width rule permanently unmatchable).

Ultimate-authored test, not derived from upstream's inputnumber.spec.ts. Verifies native input rendering, CVA writeValue/writeControlValue bridge (ControlValueAccessor contract), value coercion via Number(), min/max clamping from CVA writes and user input, reactive-forms FormControl integration, invalid/fluid class reflection, and ancestor-UFluid detection via U_FLUID_ANCESTOR token injected through UBaseInput.

Extracted via extract-primeng-source.mjs from primeng@21.1.9. Fluid→UFluid, selector p-fluid→u-fluid, host class .p-fluid→.u-fluid. Real upstream Fluid is a component with an <ng-content> template and a `p-fluid` element selector, NOT an attribute directive with a [pFluid] selector as this task's brief illustratively described — no [pFluid] selector exists anywhere in upstream source; adapted to match the real mechanism per the brief's own instruction to verify against extracted source. Deliberately excludes upstream's Bind/passthrough hostDirectives wiring and FLUID_INSTANCE/PARENT_INSTANCE injection-token parent lookup — see UBaseComponent's doc comment for the same Option B architectural exclusion pattern. Provides U_FLUID_ANCESTOR token on itself (providers: [{provide: U_FLUID_ANCESTOR, useValue: true}]) so ng-core-tier classes (e.g. UBaseInput) can detect an ancestor <u-fluid> wrapper via DI injection without ng-core depending on ng (avoids circular workspace dependency).
